identificationModule.briefTitle: SPGL008 in Combination With SSGJ-706 ± Chemotherapy for Advanced Non-small Cell Lung Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 2 Study of SPGL008 in Combination With SSGJ-706 ± Chemotherapy for Advanced Non-small Cell Lung Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study is an open, multicenter, phase 2 clinical trial of SPGL008 in combination with SSGJ-706 ± chemotherapy for the treatment of advanced non-small cell lung cancer. The objective is to evaluate the safety and efficacy of SPGL008 combined with SSGJ-706 in participants with driver gene-negative advanced non-small cell lung cancer.

interventions.name: SSGJ-706
interventions.description: SSGJ-706 is a bispecific antibody that targets both human PD-1 and PD-L1

interventions.name: SPGL008
interventions.description: SPGL008 is a dual-functional molecule that combines an anti-B7-H3 monoclonal antibody with IL-15Rα sushi / IL-15.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence of Adverse Events(AEs) assessed by NCI-CTCAE v6.0
primaryOutcomes.description: Collect and analyze the incidence of adverse events to evaluate safety and tolerability per NCI-CTCAE v6.0
The efficacy of solid tumors was evaluated according to RECIST v1.1

secondaryOutcomes.description: Collect blood samples at the preset time points, measure the concentrations, draw the concentration-time curve, and select the highest point on the curve.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Males and/or females over age 18-75
2. Histologically and/or cytologically documented local advanced or metastatic NSCLC .
3. Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0-1.
4. Expected survival \>=3 months.
5. Adequate organ or bone marrow function.
6. Signed informed consent form.

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Known positive driver genes
2. Pregnant or breast-feeding woman.
3. Adverse events (with exception of alopecia and fatigue) from any prior anticancer therapy of grade \>1 (National Cancer Institute Common terminology Criteria
4. Known allergies, hypersensitivity, or intolerance to SSGJ-706/SPGL008 The above information was not intended to contain all considerations relevant to a participant's potential participation in a clinical trial.
